integration_issues.flow: Buyer personalization upload — Playwright automation only
integration_issues.issue: Could not assert end-to-end buyer upload→add-to-cart→cart-line via Playwright. Neither `set_input_files` on the hidden `personalization-image-input` nor the `expect_file_chooser` path on `personalization-image-pick` triggered a network POST to /api/personalization/files (verified with response listener — zero requests fired). Backend endpoint itself is healthy (curl multipart round-trip returns the same bytes, .txt rejected 400). Manual UI verification of the gate toast confirmed the React handler IS wired. This appears to be a Playwright/React hidden-file-input interop limitation in this preview environment, NOT a product bug. Main agent should self-test by uploading a real photo in a browser to confirm thumbnail+cart-line+'N photos attached'.

action_items: Main agent: manually self-test the buyer upload flow (upload jpg → thumbnail in personalization-uploads → add to cart → /cart shows personalization block + 'N photos attached' for 2+) to close the one gap I couldn't automate.

Consider adding a legacy flat-variant fixture/seed product so the iter364 regression for old 1D/2D variant PDPs can be exercised — current live DB has zero products with `variants && !variant_groups`.
critical_code_review_comments: PersonalizationPanel.processFiles uses Promise.all with a shared `current` array that is mutated inside each async callback — if two uploads complete near-simultaneously, the second can overwrite the first's setFiles call because each closure captures its own snapshot. Consider switching to a setFiles(prev => [...prev, body]) functional update.

VariationGroupsSection combos table uses div-grid instead of <table><tbody><tr> — semantic but harder to selector-test. Adding `data-testid=editor-combo-row-{idx}` on each row would future-proof Playwright assertions.
